sentences.en: The office has been topsy-turvy since the merger upset everything.
sentences.zh: 自从合并打乱了所有事情以来，办公室一直混乱不堪。

sentences.en: Company attorneys are working around the clock to complete the merger.
sentences.zh: 公司律师正在加班加点地完成合并工作。

sentences.en: The merger created the first largest bank in Japan.
sentences.zh: 这次合并创造了日本最大的银行。

senses.zh: （企业等的）合并；并购；[法律]吸收（如刑法中重罪吸收轻罪）
